engines.name: FOUNDATION-XL
engines.description: Large-scale vision-language model trained primarily on English-language web data. High confidence, low cultural specificity. Tendency toward Western-centric generic labels.

engines.name: GAIA-ECO
engines.description: Trained on ecological network data. Perceives images as relational systems. Every entity is classified by its function within a living network.

engines.name: ARCHIVE-INDEX
engines.description: Trained on museum catalog metadata. Classifies objects as archival items with provenance and institutional framing. Tendency to flatten living culture into heritage categories.

engines.name: HUMAN MODE
engines.description: Remove all machine overlays. See only what the camera sees. But is unmediated perception possible?

_API_INTEGRATION_NOTES.instructions: To replace simulated data with real AI outputs, modify the `detections` array for each engine. Each detection should follow the schema: { id, label, category, confidence (0-1), boundingBox ({x,y,w,h} as percentages), metadata, error }. You can also add a `apiEndpoint` field to each engine and implement async fetching in overlay-renderer.js. The bounding box coordinates use percentage-based positioning relative to the detected image target.
suggestedAPIs: Google Cloud Vision API — for FOUNDATION-XL style outputs
iNaturalist API — for TAXON-VISION style outputs
Custom fine-tuned CLIP models — for culturally specific engines
Hugging Face Inference API — for flexible model switching
